title: The SSH host's JSON output was only checked to be an array, so a task without its fields was accepted and crashed the view
resolution: isTaskProgress validates every field and the stage range; an invalid remote answer becomes an error of that host only; test 'an SSH host with the script returns its tasks; failures are reported'

title: After the remote root was found, SSH transport failures in the fallback reader became missing data, so a dropped connection showed a host without tasks or a wrong stage
resolution: The SSH reader throws TransportError on exit 255, verifiedAt rethrows it, and readSshHost reports the host unreachable; test 'an SSH host that stops answering during the fallback is unreachable'; pass 2 found the fix incomplete (its finding M1), completed in 8093986a

title: The first active change won over the branch's own archived change, so a worktree showed another task and lost its archived or landed stage
resolution: An exact active match, then the branch's archived change, wins; another change only when it is the worktree's one change; tests 'the archived change of the branch wins over another active change' and 'a worktree with several changes, none of them the branch, is skipped'

title: The lock was stolen by age alone and removed unconditionally, so a slow refresh lost its lock and later removed another refresh's lock
resolution: scripts/task-progress-lock.ts: a hard-linked lock with pid and token, released only by its owner; eight-process test; pass 2 found the takeover racy (its finding M3), completed in 8093986a

title: A cache with only generatedAtEpoch counted as fresh, and a future timestamp blocked refreshes
resolution: readCache validates the report's shape; cacheAgeSeconds treats an invalid cache or one more than 60 s ahead as due; the status line does the same; test 'an invalid or future cache is due for a refresh'

title: A null pass line crashed the collection and {} counted as a Low-only pass
resolution: parsePasses accepts only records with four non-negative integer counts and reports other lines as task problems shown on the row; test 'corrupt pass records are reported, not counted, and never crash'

title: The spec delta did not require one row per task, the non-blocking background refresh, or the missing, stale, and corrupt cache behavior
resolution: Added the requirements 'Stacked task progress rows' and 'Progress cache refresh' with scenarios

title: The rendered time was asserted to end in :00 in the host's time zone, which fails in half-hour zones
resolution: The test file pins TZ to UTC and asserts the exact time 10-28 09:00

title: baseBefore read the merge base through verify-stamp's mergeBase, which swallowed TransportError, so a dropped SSH connection there showed wrong stage times on a host reported ok
resolution: baseBefore runs merge-base through the task reader, so TransportError reaches readSshHost; the fallback test also drops merge-base

title: Stage 8 counted every commit after the last pass record, missing a fix committed before the record and counting record-only commits after a Low-only pass
resolution: Fixes are commits after the last pass record outside openspec/changes/ and the commits that the last pass's findings name; two tests

title: Two contenders taking over one dead lock could interleave so that a live lock was moved aside and deleted, leaving two holders
resolution: Takeovers hold the exclusive file progress.lock.takeover, reread the owner under it, and never move or delete a foreign lock; release checks the token; an eight-process test on a dead owner's lock

title: A lock with a readable owner never expired, so a reused pid could block refreshes forever
resolution: A lock older than 30 minutes is abandoned whatever its pid; test 'a live owner keeps the lock until the maximum age; a dead one loses it'

title: design.md D4 still described the age-based lock that pass 1 replaced
resolution: D4 describes the owner-checked lock, the serial takeover, and the timeouts

title: The records still named 21 tests and lacked the lock module and its test file
resolution: verification.md, tasks.md, and proposal.md name both test files, the lock module, and the counts per round

title: The cache refresh requirement bound the status line, which lives outside the repository and no check covers
resolution: The requirement binds make progress-refresh only; design D6 and the protocol describe the status line

title: An archive whose name only ended with the branch, such as show-task-progress for task-progress, was taken as the task's
resolution: The archive name must be the date prefix followed by exactly the branch; test 'an archive of another change whose name ends with the branch is not the task'

title: An ssh value starting with a dash would be read by ssh as an option
resolution: The hosts file rejects such a value and ssh gets -- before the target; test 'an ssh value that ssh would read as an option is rejected'
